title: Continuity of care and keeping people informed
summary: Whether people see the same carers and are told about changes, two of the most common home care concerns.
whenToUse: Every quarter, or when people complain about unfamiliar carers or not being told about changes.

statements.focus: How many different carers each person sees, and whether changes are planned around them.
People told in advance when a carer or visit time changes.
People and families asked about their carers and visit times, and listened to.
Phones answered and calls returned, including out of hours.
Continuity and communication tracked and acted on by managers.
